name: codex-switch
description: A Windows desktop tool for switching Codex relay configurations.
author: Codex Switch

scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item Env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; electron-vite dev"
scripts.preview: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item Env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; electron-vite preview"
scripts.dist: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never && npm run prune:release
scripts.dist:installer: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never && npm run prune:release
scripts.dist:portable: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --publish never && npm run prune:release
scripts.dist:install: npm run stop:local-app && npm run dist:installer && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$installer = Join-Path (Resolve-Path .\release) ('Codex-Switch-Setup-' + $env:npm_package_version + '.exe'); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $installer)) { throw 'Installer not found' }; $process = Start-Process -FilePath $installer -ArgumentList '/S' -PassThru -Wait -WindowStyle Hidden; if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw ('Installer failed with exit code ' + $process.ExitCode) }"
scripts.pack: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
